source_documents.title: Efficient Photoinduced Energy and Electron Transfers in a Tetraphenylethene-Based Octacationic Cage Through Host-Guest Complexation

reference_evidence_units.quote: proton signals of free cage gradually disappeared, while the proton signals of the bound cage gradually appeared
reference_evidence_units.subject: AG and AV with cage 1.8Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Aqueous host-guest NMR titration, 1:1 endpoint; SI Figures S10/S11 cited.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The text reports formation of 1:1 complexes for both guests.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The underlying SI NMR traces are unavailable; no free-guest photophysical inference follows from this.

reference_evidence_units.subject: AV in cage 1.8Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1: binding constant from titration; yield in water at 10 micromolar; lifetime at cage emission 545 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The complex has Ka (2.73 +/- 0.25) x 10^7 M^-1, yield 1.2% and lifetime 4.76 ns.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are complex/cage-emission properties, not the isolated dye's emission lifetime or quantum yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: no PEnT process is observed in ﬂuorescence titration experiments
reference_evidence_units.subject: AG and AV with cage 1.8Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Cage excitation and fluorescence titration in water; absorption/emission overlap present.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports no observable sensitized energy-transfer response despite spectral overlap.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Keep this condition-specific. The discussion later hedges possible competing processes.

reference_evidence_units.quote: ﬂuorescence quenching was caused by the PET process from the electron-rich dye to the electro-deﬁcient cage
reference_evidence_units.subject: ICG, AG and AV with cage
reference_evidence_units.statement: PET from dye to cage is proposed as a quenching route.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Binding and quenching alone do not uniquely establish PET; retain the electrochemical/TA evidence separately.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the cationic cage is favorable in the cage⊃guest complexes except 1·8PF6 −⊃NiR and 1·8Cl−⊃AV
reference_evidence_units.subject: AV and NiR complexes
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Authors' discussion of ground-state CV shifts.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The CV interpretation explicitly treats AV as an exception to the shift-based electron-transfer trend.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not suppress this exception merely because excited-state TA is interpreted as PET.

reference_evidence_units.quote: absorption band at 540 nm during the ﬁrst few picoseconds
reference_evidence_units.subject: AV complex
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Femtosecond TA, cage excitation 355 nm, Figure 7d.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The target complex shows a short-lived 540 nm feature together with an AV-related 620 nm band.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The text reports 0.29 +/- 0.03 ps here and 0.29 +/- 0.05 ps later; retain the source discrepancy rather than silently harmonizing it.

reference_evidence_units.quote: which decays with the fast lifetime (τ = 6.16 ± 1 ps) through CR to the ground state
reference_evidence_units.subject: AV complex
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Authors' assignment of the femtosecond TA kinetics.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign a charge-separated state followed by charge recombination with the reported lifetime.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Assignment is not a direct charge count; the reported PL yield is 1.1% here versus 1.2% in Table 1.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Complex formation is central to the source's studied system; it is conditional on the added cage.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source assigns target-complex TA to charge separation/recombination, with the CV exception and yield discrepancy preserved.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: TPE-cage motion behavior must not be transferred to the guest SMILES.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Binding is established, but a separate confinement-induced suppression mechanism is not isolated for this guest.
